diagnosis: The acceptance condition requiring delivery authorization to wait until the corrected package is prepared and verified has no corresponding content check. A settlement can therefore authorize delivery immediately while passing every defined check.
evidence: Acceptance condition 4 is not represented in content_checks; for example, decisions={'audio_format':'2.0 PCM','open_captions':True,'audio_description_track':True,'delivery_authorized':True}, commitments=[{'type':'re-export','target':'master','detail':'complete'}], justification_fact_ids=['PF1'], and revealed=['PF1'] passes C1, C2, C3, C5, C6, and P1.
fix_instructions: Add a boolean content check that requires delivery_authorized to be false until the corrected package is prepared and verified, or extend the settlement schema with explicit preparation and verification fields and check those conditions.
